name: WNBA_R1A4_STATIC_VERSIONED_DATASET_AUDIT_V1

scope.goal: Certify static/versioned custody and structural coverage for target identity and prior-game reconstruction without opening target-game outcome values.

source_architecture.schedule_role: Fixture identity, season, team identities and pregame chronology only.
source_architecture.team_box_role: Game-level structural source for prior-game context/basic statistics; target-game outcome values remain forbidden during R1A.4.
source_architecture.custody_rule: Pin release asset id, name, size and SHA-256. A mutable tag or filename alone is not sufficient source custody. Any changed asset requires a new explicit audit before use.

2023.name: team_box_2023.parquet
2023.digest_provenance: Computed outcome-blind from asset-id-addressed bytes in R1A.4 run 33077182651 before final pinned rerun.

anti_leakage_rules: R1A.4 may inspect Parquet schema metadata, but it may not load values from forbidden target-outcome columns.
Only explicitly allowlisted columns may be projected during the empirical audit.
A later constructor may read outcomes/statistics only from games proven final strictly before the target cutoff and only after excluding the target game by canonical game_id.
No season-end/current advanced snapshot may be projected backward to an earlier target game.
Unknown historical injury or manual-adjustment state is not zero.
No target outcome, market price, target participation or post-tip information may be used to choose a source or feature rule.

known_outcome_blind_semantics_findings.espn_team_box_advanced_gap: The documented SportsDataverse ESPN team_box schema contains game identity and traditional/basic boxscore fields but does not contain off_rating, def_rating, net_rating, pace or possessions.
known_outcome_blind_semantics_findings.wnba_stats_team_season_stats_grain: SportsDataverse declares team_season_stats as a season-level leaguedashteamstats dataset, not a game-level or dated snapshot dataset.
known_outcome_blind_semantics_findings.production_preference: server/wnba-independent-routes.ts prefers advanced pace/off_rating/def_rating/net_rating and only uses estimated formulas as fallback, so a basic-boxscore derivation cannot be silently declared exact production equivalence.
known_outcome_blind_semantics_findings.referenced_raw_store: sportsdataverse/wehoop-wnba-stats-raw is referenced by current build code but is not publicly resolvable through the GitHub access path used in this audit as of 2026-08-27; it is therefore not an eligible certified source for R1A.4.

decision_policy.full_sports_only_v1_reconstruction_certi: A separately frozen exact-enough advanced as-of source/derivation plus resolution of the injury/manual-state gates.
